name: Mentor — Raion Community
relation: Mentored Firdaus in the Product Learning Path
content: Firdaus demonstrated outstanding leadership as Head of Product Learning Path at Raion Community. He successfully designed and delivered a structured PM bootcamp for 20+ high-potential professionals, maintaining a 90% completion rate throughout the program. His ability to simplify complex product concepts and inspire teammates was remarkable. He consistently showed initiative, deep empathy for users, and a strong commitment to building impactful digital products. I am confident he will excel in any product or design role he pursues.

name: Supervisor — PT Sekawan Media Informatika
content: Firdaus joined our team as a Project Manager Intern and quickly proved himself as a reliable, detail-oriented contributor. He played a key role in gathering and translating stakeholder requirements into clear technical specifications, and his proactive approach to gap analysis helped us reduce development delays by 25%. He communicated clearly across technical and non-technical teams and always kept the project aligned with business goals. I would highly recommend Firdaus for any project management or product role.

name: Team Lead — Magna Partners
relation: Worked directly with Firdaus on product development
content: Firdaus was one of the most impactful interns I've had the pleasure of working with. During his time at Magna Partners, he authored over 20 PRDs and user stories and introduced MoSCoW prioritization to our workflow — directly contributing to more predictable sprint delivery. His structured thinking, collaborative attitude, and deep user empathy make him an ideal candidate for any product or BA role. He is a self-starter who consistently goes beyond what is expected.
